title: Negative-output pivotality
statement: Let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, let $i$ be a coordinate in $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $x$ be an input. The coordinate $i$ is negative-output pivotal for $f$ at $x$ exactly when $f(x)=-1$ and coordinate $i$ is pivotal for $f$ at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
caveat: The predicate IsPivotal is not defined in the supplied snippet.
